newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisie Leasing H1 profit up 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunisie Leasing H1 profit up 50 pct.

text.p: Tunisie Leasing, a privately owned leasing firm, made a 2.335 million dinars pretax profit during the first half of 1997, up 50 percent compared to 1.555 million dinars during the same period last year, results showed on Monday.
Total balance sheet amounted to 129.348 million dinars, up from 107.484 million dinars.

The company said its main shareholders were Amen Bank, Tunisian-Saudi STUSID bank, BEST bank, UIB bank, and Maghrebia Assurances. The five shareholders have a 43 percent stake, while the public owns 30 percent.
Ten international funds detain the remaining 27 percent previously owned by France's Credit Lyonnais. ($=1.146 dinar)
